title: Verifier verdicts
description: runs/<paper-slug>/verify/verdicts.json. Generated by agents/verifier/verify_run.py next to RESULTS.md, from the executed check scripts. The Writer reads it and does not edit it. Read `claims` for the report; `checks` is the per-script evidence.

verdict.description: Is the paper's claim right? HOLDS: yes. FAILS: no. UNCHECKED: not settled; the detail says why.

evidence_kind.description: How the verdict was reached. HOLDS: proof (Lean) > symbolic > asymptotic > numerical. FAILS: refutation (Lean proves the negation) > symbolic > asymptotic > counterexample. UNCHECKED: none. numerical means sampled, not proved; say so in the report.

paper.description: Paper slug: the run directory name.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 time of the verify_run call.

commit.description: Repo commit the checks ran on, with a note if the tree had uncommitted changes.

claims.description: One entry per equation: every equation in equations.json if present, otherwise every equation a check names.

check_id.description: The check whose result is shown. null if no check tests the claim.

script.description: Path of that check script, relative to the run directory.

detail.description: What the script printed after the verdict, e.g. the counterexample, or why the claim is unchecked.

conflict.description: true if checks of this claim disagree. The verdict is then UNCHECKED and a person must look.

correction.description: Only for FAILS. The corrected equation from a correction check of this claim. Report it as a correction only if verified is true; otherwise as an unverified suggestion.

verified.description: true only if the correction check printed HOLDS.

role.description: claim: tests the equation as printed. correction: tests a corrected form of it. supporting: anything else.

claim.description: Equation number for claim and correction checks, else null.

verdict.description: What the script printed. ERROR: the script is broken (no or malformed VERDICT line, crash, timeout, or evidence not allowed).
